name: java-tu-ti-generator
description: Generate or update Java 8/11 unit and integration tests while following the conventions already present in the repository.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Java unit and integration tests
interface.longDescription: Generate or update Java 8/11 unit tests and integration tests by first detecting the conventions of the current module, then matching its JUnit, Mockito, Spring and Maven patterns.
defaultPrompt: Generate unit tests for this Java class.
Add integration tests for this method.
Complete the missing tests while matching this module.
